title: Approximation by a junta
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose the total influence $I(f)$ is positive and the total squared Fourier coefficient mass on subsets of size greater than $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$. Set $\tau=\dfrac{\varepsilon^2}{I(f)^2}\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)^k$, and let $J$ consist of the coordinates whose Boolean influence is at least $\tau$. Then there is a Boolean function $g$ depending on at most $|J|$ coordinates such that the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
